title: Vibrant Crunchy Portuguese Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Portuguese lentil stew with a crunchy twist, perfect for a sick day, featuring sherry and fermented flavors in a Jain-friendly dish, where the dough is kneaded to create a crispy crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the sherry and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add the lentils, kale, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the fermented vegetable broth and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
While the stew is cooking, knead the whole wheat bread until it becomes pliable and easy to shape.
Shape the bread into a crust and place it on top of the stew.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
